authorReviewNote: Impostor secretly eliminates crew. Crewmate, Scientist and Guardian Angel crew-side roles not killers. Publisher actual premise checked. No claim only one Impostor per match; article singular role name fine.

Crewmates complete tasks; race laps, crafting recipes and league fixtures not Among Us crew objectives. Publisher explicit task bar. Replaced off-topic restaurant/football options with game-system alternatives. Category and grammar sound.
Voting ejects suspect. Repairing, weapons and escape pod don't perform group ejection. Actual Innersloth gameplay explicitly vote to eject inspected. Does not imply votes always identify an Impostor.

Replaced Skeld spaceship candidate because found official passage referred to VR Skeld II, not original map. New vents question directly verified Innersloth how-to. Other options not Impostor movement systems. Some Crewmates can also vent, so does not call venting exclusive to Impostors.

Standard Fortnite BR seeks last surviving player/team. Fixed race score, flag capture and collecting all map items other modes, not standard win condition. Publisher-owned Epic island actual description inspected; not creator-authored fan island.

Standard BR storm makes safe area smaller. Expansion, unchanged area and pre-fight disappearance wrong. Official Final Fight patch compares exception stopping early with standard circles closing in. Scoped standard avoids creative and special event rules.
V-Bucks Fortnite currency, Robux/Minecoins/Bells belong other games. Epic's own product description explicitly defines in-game currency. No outdated price or platform-transfer claim included.

Axe appropriate wood tool; shovel soil, hoe farming, fishing rod angling. Official Minecraft beginner guide explicitly wood using stone axe. Does not say only axes can break wood or require a particular material.
Furnace smelts using fuel. Chest/bookshelf/loom different functions. Official beginner guide smelting and coal fuel checked. Blast furnace omitted because also valid ore-smelting answer.

Sheep sheared for wool; pig/cow/chicken not wool-producing options. Official shears article actual text explicitly sheep and wool. Normally allows already-sheared lamb exceptions; no claim shears work exclusively on sheep.

Robux Roblox currency. Other three real currencies from other titles. Actual indexed Roblox parent/caregiver guide explicitly official currency checked; direct unrelated parents-controls page not sufficient and replaced.

Studio creates experiences. Other options software operations not its main purpose. Official educational glossary indexed actual definition checked; direct PDF fetch unsupported content-type honestly retained. Does not imply authors need pay for Studio.

Community creators build much of platform content. Exclusively internal studio/hardware makers/film companies false. Roblox own annual-report indexed developer/creator paragraph corroborates. Much avoids unsupported claim every single experience is independent community content.
Grandfather inherited farm, aunt/cousin/sister not opening benefactor. Actual Stardew creator about page inspected. No need claim relative still alive or exact date.

Fishing rod catches fish, not insects/birds/rabbits. Creator about page explicitly fishing, fish, bait and bobbers. Removed repeated only wording. Fish wording doesn't falsely imply rods never hook trash/treasure.

Overcooked chefs prepare/serve dishes. Farming, floor design and town delivery different sim activities. Team17 actual cooking/recipes/service setting inspected. Can do ancillary tasks but main job clause disambiguates.
Cooperative cooking recognised core multiplayer, unlike kart racing/shooting/card battles. Team17 explicitly couch/online co-op. Best known wording does not deny competitive versus mode exists.
Up to four normal co-op participants, not maximum two/six/eight. Publisher explicitly up to four. To avoid up-to-two subset interpretation, maximum wording should be explicit in final prompt.

Throw ingredients across shifting kitchens, publisher explicitly inspected. Other actions invented alternatives. Across gap can help, not blanket claim every item can be thrown or every gap traversed.
Village setting explicit developer homepage. Space station/underwater city/bunker incorrect. No England claim inferred from aesthetics. Main setting normal scope permits several village areas.
Cat protagonist, not dog/fox/rabbit. Publisher Steam synopsis explicit. Distinct from later drone/escape goal questions, not a duplicated release-year fact.
B-12 companion drone, other named robots not Stray. Actual publisher narrative paragraph explicit. Hyphen spelling correct and no claim all characters know its backstory.

Escape forgotten cybercity to reach home. Other confined settings false. Actual publisher overview explicit. Improved irrelevant race/sports distractors into places; avoids naming city if not officially given.
Two players by design; one/three/four not core game. Actual EA purely-for-two couch/online passage inspected. Does not assert both players must buy full copies.
Cody and May named playable couple, other familiar pairs different games. Actual EA passage explicit. No claim other pairs share same relationship dynamics.

Players cooperate through connected abilities. Single-winner competition, unrelated campaigns and one-character turn-taking not designed play. Actual EA pure co-op and connected abilities inspected. Removed uninstall joke; distinct teamwork concept from numeric player count.

Side-on 2D action-adventure, alternatives other viewpoints. Developer actual 2D description plus Nintendo official store explicit side-scrolling feature checked. No screenshot inspection claimed. Replaced spreadsheet/news-desk nonsense with game viewpoints. Does not claim all art has no depth effects.

1930s cartoons official inspiration, other decades incorrect. Studio actual animation paragraph inspected. Decade question not release year, traditional animation/jazz not overextended to every frame's production technique.
Original two-player partner Mugman. Luigi/Tails/Diddy different franchises; original qualifier avoids DLC Ms. Chalice alternate. Actual Studio premise names Cuphead and Mugman and local co-op.
Boss battles prominent, other game formats not central. Studio explicit screen-filling bosses inspected. Does not imply no run-and-gun platform stages.
Debt to Devil after casino, not Bowser/Eggman/Dedede. Actual Studio plot explicitly debts/souls at Devil casino. Fictional story question not a real gambling instruction.
Aperture Science testing labs, not Black Mesa/Umbrella/Abstergo. Actual Valve Steam description explicitly lab name. Black Mesa shared universe distractor remains wrong facility operator here.
